Distinguished from SPIDER evidence; used to weight Frontier tunnel diagnosis and require fresh-context reset.

Distinguished from SPIDER evidence; used to prioritize honest cost instrumentation over n*3200/jitter proxies.

Agent prior: tool/API bypass and deterministic selector compilation dominate work compression when site internals are stable, while DOM/AX reasoning dominates when volatile; optimal architecture is hybrid with learned dispatch, not pure browsing or pure catalog. Distinguished from SPIDER evidence; used to judge Frontier WebAPI vs DSM-IR shootout as directionally correct but invalidated by noisy AX and contamination, and to require site-stability as experimental factor.

Agent prior: caching/replay without freshness and per-value alias handling degenerates to replay-like behavior under shift; calibration (ECE<=0.15) and abstention (UNKNOWN precision>=0.85, FA<=0.10) are product-critical, and literal high-confidence mechanisms win ties unless tie-break includes parameter-slot-count and recalibrated 0.95/0.85 confidence. Distinguished from SPIDER evidence; used to require calibrated gating before any VALIDATED promotion.

C-WEB-DYNAMICS is BLOCKED after 72 exps with independent-noise models baking in null and PMI leakage. Core product claims C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-LLM-INHERIT/C-PRODUCT-ECON remain HYPOTHESIS with repeated invalid honest-cost accounting (n*3200, f*6.0, jitter). Bottleneck is measurement substrate validity, not idea scarcity. Highest information now is (1) restoring a minimal honest single-node health gate then distributed WAL, (2) parking re-attempts that re-use invalid scaffolds, and (3) forcing residual-novelty economics to be tested with honest sum-counters vs external O(1) compilation baselines.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: Scout brief was central but not authoritative. Adopted its diagnosis of evidence-rich yet progress-narrow state, 17-streak Frontier trap, 52-streak Runtime and 15-streak Product tunnels, and cross-lane dependencies (Runtime shared-WAL blocks Graph FRESHNESS/DELTA-REPAIR; Intel census blocks Graph/Product param-inherit; Physics independent-noise models are degenerate). Adopted its external context (Agentic Compilation O(1) $0.002-0.092, TraceCompiler def-use, browser-memory deterministic capsule, WebGym 300k/BrowserGym) as directionally raising bar for residual-novelty/product economics, but did not treat those external numbers as SPIDER evidence - instead assigned Intel to reproduce them on SPIDER's 40-task alias-OOD with trajectory-grouped CIs and honest cost. Challenged Scout's suggested reactivations where they would duplicate invalid scaffolds: rejected continued Frontier alias/routing permutations and repeated Physics TodoMVC PMI/timescale repeats at N=1000 with same SPA manifest; instead forced PARK for Physics pending larger manifest with session/permission regimes and single-node-first hardening for Runtime.
